findings.evidence: ## Your Task restates that the orchestrator drives a review-and-fix loop and never edits the document, which the steps already specify.
findings.fix: Delete the Your Task section; start at Inputs.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md is 496 lines, at the process-pattern ceiling, with the loop's branch detail still in the body rather than only in gated references.
findings.fix: Move the Step 1 route prose that duplicates cross-ai-dispatch.md into that file and leave a one-line gate in the loop.

findings.evidence: ## NEVER lists two landmines and defers the rest to the Hard rules table, so the landmines are split across two sections.
findings.fix: Keep one NEVER list and point the Hard rules table at it instead of repeating rules.

findings.evidence: Description names frameworks and flags but not the near-miss of reviewing code or a pull request rather than a spec, plan, or design document.
findings.fix: Use when a design, spec, requirements, or plan document needs review-and-fix before the next step, even if the user only says "review this" and passes a document path. Framework-aware across superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, BMAD, and generic docs. Orchestrates a reviewer and routes fixes through the framework skill, slash command, or direct-edit fixer, with optional --cross-ai/--no-cross-ai reviewer dispatch. Not for code review, PR review, or editing the document in this session.

findings.evidence: Every run must read all of references/cross-ai-dispatch.md (385 lines), including when --no-cross-ai skips only points 3-6.
findings.fix: Gate the full file on a cross-AI or subprocess route; for --no-cross-ai, require only the path-resolution section.

findings.evidence: ranking-weights.toml is loaded by model_ranker.py and is never named in SKILL.md or a reference as a conditional read.
findings.fix: In Step 0.7, say to read references/ranking-weights.toml only when explaining or changing model-ranking weights.

findings.evidence: Probe-quota says two parts of the shipped walk go beyond the owner quote and are not owner-ruled yet, then still tells the agent to walk them and say so.
findings.fix: State one default: walk the configured ladder, name both extra cases in the Step 5 message, and stop after dispatch.

findings.evidence: No evals/evals.json or evals/trigger-queries.json. The four eval markdown files use the retired name review-spec and have prose pass criteria, not assertions.
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with at least three prompts, expected output, and verifiable assertions, and evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 should and should-not queries including near-misses.

findings.evidence: The package entry calls argparse and exits with a status, and the listed test modules cover it, but the runner script references/cross-ai.mjs has no --help usage text.
findings.fix: Add a --help path to references/cross-ai.mjs that prints usage, flags, and exit codes to stdout.

findings.evidence: The diagram's first edge is Start to Dispatch reviewer, skipping the pending-lane resume that enters mid-loop, and it has no Failure or hard-tier wait node.
findings.fix: Add a resume entry into the pending-lane wait, and a Failure status edge from Parse Status line to Surface to user.
